meta.name: Dekid Wu OS Portfolio
meta.description: macOS-inspired spatial portfolio: dark 3D Macintosh intro, then a light glass desktop with widgets, dock, Finder/Notes windows, iPod, and long-form case studies.

primary.role: primary text, active sidebar, dock labels

accent.role: status dot on View All Projects / All Projects List tab

neutral.usage: Light canvas #E0E0E0 for OS desktop; near-black #121212 for intro overlay and 404; white translucent glass for windows

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast dark-on-light on the desktop; inverted white-on-#121212 for intro, case-study heroes, and 404

font_families.heading: PP Monument Grotesk (Monument), fallback Avenir Next
font_families.mono: system UI mono used only for intro leetspeak overlays

typography.font_style_notes: Geometric-grotesk display (Monument) for the hero sentence; Avenir Next for all UI chrome, lists, and case-study body. Intro overlay uses a monospaced glitch/leetspeak treatment that is decorative, not informational.

spacing.section_rhythm: Desktop is spatial, not sectional — widgets sit on a large canvas with ~24–48px gaps. Case studies use long vertical rhythm with large dark-space between media blocks.

layout.grid_system: No traditional 12-col page grid on home. Spatial absolute canvas plus fixed chrome (top-left tab, top-right clock/sound, bottom dock, bottom-left visual map). Projects list uses a 3-column row: section label | year | title+role. Finder overlay is 4×3 icon grid inside an 840px modal.
layout.max_content_width: Case studies ~1200px; Notes window 640×480; Finder grid 840px / 88vw
layout.columns: Desktop: freeform. Projects list: 3. Finder: 4. Notes: sidebar 160px + content.
layout.gutter: 16–24px between widgets; 1px hairline dividers on project list rows
layout.breakpoints: Desktop-first. Author states mobile is a basic adaptation. dvh used for window max-height.
layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric spatial composition on desktop; left-aligned editorial lists on /projects; centered 3D object on intro

border_radius.pill: 999px (sound toggle, dock, contact chip, TOC/close bars)

shape.border_usage: mostly none; glass uses 1px inset white highlight instead of stroke; sound toggle has 1px white border
shape.divider_style: 1px #E4E4E4 hairlines on project list; 1px black/15 vertical separators in dock

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused plus glass inset highlight

levels.high: Finder/Notes overlay over blurred desktop; intro Macintosh casts contact shadow in 3D scene

elevation.depth_cues: frosted glass, overlapping widgets, 3D Macintosh, iPod coverflow rotateY, visual-map miniature of the canvas

iconography.style: photoreal macOS Big Sur/Sonoma app icons in dock and Finder; tiny brand badges (Figma, Claude, Rive) as 6–17px chips
iconography.preferred_set: custom PNG dock icons + brand SVGs, not a generic icon font

motion.easing: spring mass 0.5 / stiffness 220 / damping 24 for window open; 200ms transform on project-card hover

duration_scale.macro: intro scroll-zoom ~1.5 viewport heights (~2s of user scroll)

motion.entrance_pattern: Intro: scroll-scrubbed camera push into Macintosh screen, then overlay unmounts. Windows: opacity 0 + scale 0.86 spring to 1. Coverflow: neighboring albums scale 0.72, rotateY ±28°, opacity 0.55.
motion.exit_pattern: Windows scale to 0.92 and fade; intro does not reverse once entered
motion.philosophy: cinematic intro, then playful OS microinteractions (peel stickers, click-wheel, dock, draggable windows)

components.button_style: Pill glass chips; yellow-dot + label + optional close X for navigation tabs; black/white pills on case-study chrome (Close / View Website / Contact Me)
components.input_style: Finder search: pill, transparent field, 16px body, placeholder #676767, magnifying-glass SVG
components.card_style: glass-card: rgba(255,255,255,0.45), radius 22px, inset white 1px, optional 8/16 padding. Project cards are image-led with caption under the poster.
components.navigation_pattern: Fixed OS chrome + spatial canvas panning + Visual Map minimap. Secondary routes: /projects list and /projects/[slug] case studies.
components.modal_style: macOS windows: traffic lights, 16px backdrop-blur, 1.8 saturate, draggable titlebar, centered with translate(-50%,-50%). Finder is a Launchpad overlay (icon grid + search), not a file-tree Finder.
components.list_style: Projects page: year + Monument/Avenir title · subtitle, role in #676767, hairline separators. Notes sidebar: 14px medium, active row bg #1B1B1B text #FDFDFD rounded-lg.
components.component_notes: Shared TrafficLights (close/minimize/zoom). Window manager via useWindow z-index + focus. Custom events notes:open / notes:close. Sound is a 24×48px glass switch. Contact is a fixed glass toast-card with mail glyph.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A personal Macintosh that boots into a living macOS desktop; the portfolio is an operating system, not a landing page
aesthetic.era_influence: Classic Macintosh hardware + modern macOS Sonoma glass + Y2K/leetspeak intro overlay
aesthetic.genre: interactive OS-portfolio / creative director personal site

visual_language.ornamentation: decorative physical objects (stickers, iPod, Macintosh) plus otherwise quiet UI chrome
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous dark void on intro; medium on desktop canvas; large dark-space in case-study heroes
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: intro mass is the 3D computer; desktop mass is the centered profile window plus scattered project posters; case studies put product UI screenshots as the visual hero
visual_language.focal_strategy: progressive reveal: stickered Mac → zoom into screen → spatial desktop → optional case study
visual_language.texture_usage: plastic 3D casing, peelable vinyl stickers, frosted glass, photoreal album art, product screenshots

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast plus spatial isolation; Monument sentence is the only large type on the desktop
composition.flow_direction: intro is vertical scroll; desktop is horizontal/planar pan; case studies are vertical editorial scroll
composition.grouping_strategy: OS objects: widgets, windows, dock, minimap. Content grouped by Recents vs Past on the list page.
composition.negative_space_role: The grey canvas is the desk surface; empty space is part of the OS metaphor, not leftover margin

imagery.photo_treatment: full-bleed product UI captures, slightly overlapping and rounded; album photography unfiltered
imagery.illustration_style: line-art sunglasses avatar (looping WebM) plus toy/character project art
imagery.graphic_elements: traffic lights, yellow status dot, brand tool badges, iPod click wheel, visual-map rectangles
imagery.pattern_usage: none as wallpaper; intro uses glitch monospace blocks in corners
imagery.image_shape: rounded rectangles 16–24px; circular avatar; squircle Finder icons

interaction_feel.feedback_style: physical: peel, press-and-drag wheel, springy window spawn, hover scale on posters
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: project posters scale ~1.02 in 200ms; dock icons lift; sidebar rows tint black/4%
interaction_feel.transition_personality: smooth glide with a short spring on windows; cinematic camera on intro
interaction_feel.loading_style: intro is the loader — Macintosh screen shows a snapshot of the desktop before you enter
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: high on home (stickers, sound, iPod, Finder, Notes, map); low on projects list; medium on case studies (TOC, media carousels)

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: casual first-person on the desktop ('Hi there, I'm Dekid… Let's create digital magic together!'); rigorous product-design English in case studies
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: friendly invitation — Contact Me, View Website, View All Projects — never urgency
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: default Next.js 404; Finder search filters the icon grid

overview.fallback_strategy: prefers-reduced-motion is read for map animation; mobile is a simplified adaptation; intro overlay can be skipped after first enter in-session
overview.primary_technology: React Three Fiber / Three.js (Fable5 Macintosh), Rive, sticker-forge, Framer Motion, CSS backdrop-filter

background_effects.description: Solid #121212 intro void and solid #E0E0E0 desktop. No animated mesh gradient behind the OS.

3d_elements.description: Beige compact Macintosh with floppy slot, power button, and a screen that displays a live/snapshot of the desktop. Camera dollies in on scroll until the overlay dismisses.
3d_elements.technology: React Three Fiber + Three.js, credited by the author as Fable5 + Three.js

params.lighting: soft studio lighting, matte plastic, screen glow
params.camera: scroll-scrubbed dolly/zoom into the CRT, slight low angle
params.materials: off-white plastic, glass screen with homepage-screen.png texture, vinyl stickers as separate meshes/decals
params.interaction_model: scroll-driven camera; stickers independently peelable; power button present

shader_effects.description: Likely used for screen glow / sticker peel shading; exact GLSL not inspectable. Sticker-forge handles peel lighting.

params.vertex_manipulation: sticker mesh lift along peel axis
params.fragment_output: plastic specular + paper underside on peel

parallax.depth_range: camera-to-screen distance compressed to 0 as you enter
parallax.speed_curve: pinned/hijacked scroll across ~2430px then overlay unmounts

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: intro progress 0→1 maps to camera; case-study media has in-view current-state buttons
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: camera dolly, overlay fade, window spring
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: intro is scrubbed; desktop is not; case studies are native scroll

scroll_morphing.description: Macintosh framing morphs from object-in-void to full-bleed desktop as the camera enters the screen

text_effects.description: Intro corners use leetspeak / scrambled monospace that visually ticks (N3xt-G3n Br@Nd Sy5tem). Desktop H1 is static Monument.

cursor_effects.description: Native cursor. Grab/grabbing on window titlebars. No custom blob cursor.

image_effects.description: iPod albums use CSS 3D coverflow. Project posters scale on hover. Case-study product shots layer with overlap, no hover distortion.

params.reveal_animation: none on posters; iPod neighbors fade to 0.55

canvas_drawings.description: WebGL canvas for Macintosh; a smaller 300×150 canvas is present (Rive and/or sticker helper). Visual Map is DOM rectangles, not a drawn canvas.

params.animation_loop: rAF while intro overlay mounted; Rive loop on avatar

svg_animations.description: SVG used as static badges and stickers (Claude padded SVG), not SMIL path draws.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The site is two worlds composited: (1) a cinematic WebGL intro with peelable sticker-forge decals, Rive/WebM avatar on the Mac screen, and leetspeak HUD; (2) a CSS glass OS with Framer Motion windows, a pannable widget canvas, coverflow iPod with real mp3s, Launchpad Finder, Notes resume, and a separate dark editorial case-study template. Hosted on Vercel Next.js App Router. Desktop-optimized; mobile is intentionally unfinished per the author.
